title: The Legend of Sleepy Hollow
author: Washington Irving
hook: A schoolteacher vanished on the road home. Was it a ghost, or someone who wanted him gone?
public_domain_note: Public domain. Source: Project Gutenberg eBook #41 (complete story).

characters.name: Hans Van Ripper
characters.description: A practical farmer and Ichabod’s former host.
characters.personality: Blunt, guarded, and impatient with superstition.
characters.knowledge_limits: Knows what he found among Ichabod’s belongings and what he did afterward; does not know what happened on the road.
never_reveal: Do not claim to have witnessed Ichabod’s disappearance.

glossary.student_friendly_definition: A person responsible for handling someone’s belongings after death or disappearance.
A tendency to believe things too easily.
Beyond what ordinary nature can explain.

scenes.narration: Morning light reaches the empty schoolhouse. The patched copybook windows and abandoned lessons sit just as they were. Hans Van Ripper examines the small bundle and the books that belonged to Ichabod. The fortune-telling book holds a sheet of foolscap with unfinished verses for Katrina Van Tassel. Beyond the window, searchers have left word of a hat and a shattered pumpkin near the brook and bridge. What disappeared: a schoolteacher, a rival, or the truth between them?
scenes.dok_task: The searchers found a hat and a shattered pumpkin. Ichabod owned books about witchcraft. Which explanation does the evidence support better: a ghost or a trick? What can’t you prove yet?
